text: ui-view releases-list (Shadows) says the picker „Compare shadow:” is preset from the `ref` param, but not what the tab selects when it is opened without `ref` (a click on the Shadows tab, or `/releases?tab=shadow`). Assumed: the first shadow of `GET /api/git/shadows` is preselected and compared, as the Compare tab presets the latest release; with an empty list the tab shows `shadow-none`.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-4602 — without a `ref` the first listed shadow is preselected, as Compare presets the latest release.
